notes: Prepared the EHIC before accession: a Regulation on EHIC adopted in December 2011 and preparations "reaching completion" in 2012 (HRV-EU-2012-001). The only case in the project where the domestic preconditions were completed before accession. Evidence before 2020 needs a logged exception, as LIM-0027.

EHIC recognised in the Law on compulsory health insurance but introduced only after accession; 2025 key recommendation to prepare a feasibility study on the card's impact on public finances. Chapter 2 closed in 2026 (MNE-EU-2026-002), so it shows what the Commission accepted for closure.
Same 2025 recommendation as Moldova's wording (develop IT infrastructure for EHIC and EESSI); EHIC-use agreements with nine Member States; no development in 2025. A contrast case rather than a model.
Its issue is access through bilateral EHIC agreements (RI-FMW-011), not domestic preconditions; little to learn on the card or health information system.
Same recommendation, but "no progress was made on the European Health Insurance Card" in 2025.
